text: Peverell Semiconductors cut 310 jobs this week, according to notices handed out Monday at its North Quay plant and confirmed by staff leaving the site at dusk. I spoke with shift supervisor Lena Voss, who said the layoffs hit production, maintenance and office teams after a brief meeting with managers. “They told us the line would keep running, just smaller,” she said outside the gate. A company memo I was shown cites “market adjustment and reduced orders” as the reason. Several workers said they were given immediate severance and asked to clear lockers by Friday. The cuts leave the Harrow Street facility with about 740 employees, down from just over 1,050 in January.
